description: MPR.10 demonstration stand with predominantly printed structure, purchased screw drives and motors, and two separate bearings supporting every output shaft.
releaseRequirements: Confirm the delivered motor, ball screw, ball nut and bearing revisions and measure their mounting interfaces before fabrication.

Assign material grades, print orientations, fit allowances and inspection criteria to every fabricated detail; qualify bearing seats, fastener engagement, layer strength, creep and wear on the actual prints.
Verify the complete moving assembly against the measured 86 mm tube bore, including the selected motion limits, shaft retention and installed fastener heads.

Fit both bearing seats on each output shaft coaxially and verify free rotation after installing the inner-ring washers and metal E-clips; qualify the fixed outer-race seats and the sliding rear screw support.

Specify and inspect custom screw journals, output-shaft flats and grooves, follower-pin grooves, washers and stepped follower sleeves; the purchased screw family does not establish these machining details.

Verify the nut's shaped flange retention, recessed sleeve-flange capture, removable keeper and free transverse follower travel throughout the demonstration sweep; qualify the captured fork's antirotation constraint on the assembled stand.
Qualify the assembled demonstration stand on a stationary bench; the supplied reference topology and library geometry do not establish loads, fatigue life or an operating rating.
